audiences: Readers comparing documented ES deployment and edition scope
exclusions: The reviewed scope does not establish unlisted compatibility, customer enablement, entitlement or authorization.

rationale: The current combined Premier workflow retains Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and aggregate ES 8.6+ with paired SOAR. The versioned task section sets Cloud ES 8.7+ and includes enabled assistant, existing findings and inherited SOAR permissions. Historical 8.7 evidence keeps its own name and scope. CMP task and indexed setup specify Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+. Current 2.3.6 Cloud Connected exclusions remain. ES 8.8 GA and the regional/edition tables do not establish exact pairing, per-agent rollout, component entitlement or customer authorization.
